title: Leukocyte Nuclear Morphology Alterations in Dilated Cardiomyopathy Caused by a Lamin AC Truncating Mutation (LMNA/Ser431*) Are Modified by the Presence of a LAP2 Missense Polymorphism (TMPO/Arg690Cys).
authors: Gonzalez-Garrido, Antonia; Rosas-Madrigal, Sandra; Rojo-Dominguez, Arturo; Arellanes-Robledo, Jaime; Lopez-Mora, Enrique; Carnevale, Alessandra; Arregui, Leticia; Rosendo-Gutierrez, Rigoberto; Romero-Hidalgo, Sandra; Villarreal-Molina, Maria Teresa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究LMNA截短突变与LAP2多态性对白细胞核形态的影响，虽涉及蛋白建模与对接，但核心是核纤层蛋白-核膜蛋白互作而非TF-DNA，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The clinical phenotype of LMNA-associated dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) varies even among individuals who share the same mutation. LMNA encodes lamin AC, which interacts with the lamin-associated protein 2 alpha (LAP2alpha) encoded by the TMPO gene. The LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys polymorphism is frequent in Latin America and was previously found to disrupt LAP2alpha-Lamin AC interactions in vitro. We identified a DCM patient heterozygous for both a lamin AC truncating mutation (Ser431*) and the LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys polymorphism. We performed protein modeling and docking experiments, and used confocal microscopy to compare leukocyte nuclear morphology among family members with different genotype combinations (wild type, LAP2alpha Arg690Cys heterozygous, lamin AC/Ser431* heterozygous, and LAP2alpha Arg690Cys/lamin AC Ser431* double heterozygous). Protein modeling predicted that 690Cys destabilizes the LAP2alpha homodimer and impairs lamin AC-LAP2alpha docking. Lamin AC-deficient nuclei (Ser431* heterozygous) showed characteristic blebs and invaginations, significantly decreased nuclear area, and increased elongation, while LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys heterozygous nuclei showed a lower perimeter and higher circularity than wild-type nuclei. LAP2alpha Arg690Cys apparently attenuated the effect of LMNA Ser431* on the nuclear area and fully compensated for its effect on nuclear circularity. Altogether, the data suggest that LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys may be one of the many factors contributing to phenotype variation of LMNA-associated DCM.
abstract_zh: LMNA相关扩张型心肌病（DCM）的临床表型即使在携带相同突变的个体之间也存在差异。LMNA编码lamin A/C，其与由TMPO基因编码的lamin相关蛋白2α（LAP2alpha）相互作用。LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys多态性在拉丁美洲常见，且先前研究发现其在体外破坏LAP2alpha-Lamin A/C相互作用。我们鉴定出一名同时杂合携带lamin A/C截短突变（Ser431*）和LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys多态性的DCM患者。我们进行了蛋白质建模和对接实验，并使用共聚焦显微镜比较了不同基因型组合（野生型、LAP2alpha Arg690Cys杂合、lamin A/C/Ser431*杂合，以及LAP2alpha Arg690Cys/lamin A/C Ser431*双杂合）家庭成员的白细胞核形态。蛋白质建模预测690Cys使LAP2alpha同源二聚体不稳定，并损害lamin A/C-LAP2alpha对接。lamin A/C缺陷核（Ser431*杂合）显示出特征性泡状突起和内陷，核面积显著减小，伸长率增加，而LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys杂合核与野生型核相比，周长较低且圆度较高。LAP2alpha Arg690Cys明显减弱了LMNA Ser431*对核面积的影响，并完全补偿了其对核圆度的影响。总体而言，数据表明LAP2alpha/Arg690Cys可能是导致LMNA相关DCM表型变异的众多因素之一。
